name: 60514 · Clarendon Hls, IL
findings: ZIP 60514 (Clarendon Hls) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60514 (Clarendon Hls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60514 (Clarendon Hls) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
